items.question: How long without activity makes a task stalled, and is the boundary inclusive?
items.ticket: Tasks with no submissions for 14 days are flagged
items.chose: Flags a task as stalled when at least 14 × 24 hours have passed since its last activity (>=, so exactly 14 days counts).
items.instead: Use a strict greater-than, so exactly 14 days is not flagged. Or count whole calendar days.

items.question: For a task with no submissions, when does the 14-day clock start?
items.ticket: Tasks with no submissions for 14 days are flagged
items.chose: Counts from the posting time when there are no submissions.
items.instead: Never flag a task that has no submissions. Or count from the first time the task was opened or assigned.

items.question: For a task that has submissions, is the 14 days measured from the latest submission or the first?
items.ticket: Tasks with no submissions for 14 days are flagged
items.chose: Measures from the latest submission time, so a task stalls when its most recent submission is 14 or more days old.
items.instead: Flag only tasks that have had no submissions at all in the last 14 days since posting. Or measure from the first submission.

items.question: Which tasks count as open?
items.ticket: Digest is skipped when nothing is open
items.chose: Includes only tasks whose status is exactly "open". All other statuses are excluded.
items.instead: Treat other in-progress statuses as open too. Or exclude only closed and merged tasks.

items.question: What does the digest return when nothing is open?
items.ticket: Digest is skipped when nothing is open
items.chose: Returns null when there are no open tasks, including when the task list is empty.
items.instead: Return a digest with an empty task list. Or throw.

items.question: In what order are tasks listed?
items.chose: Puts stalled tasks first, then oldest posted first, then by id ascending.
items.instead: Keep the input order. Or sort by age descending or by furthest gate.

items.question: How is a task's age computed and what unit is used?
items.ticket: listing each open task with its age
items.chose: Reports age as whole 24-hour periods from posting to now, rounded down and never negative (a future posting date gives 0).
items.instead: Round to the nearest day or round up. Or count calendar days in the organization's time zone.

items.question: What is the furthest gate for a task with no submissions?
items.chose: Reports gate 0 when there are no submissions, and otherwise the highest gate among all submissions.
items.instead: Return null or undefined to show that no gate was reached.

items.question: What does the digest subject say and how does it handle singular counts?
items.chose: Builds the subject "Weekly digest: N open tasks, M stalled" and always uses the plural "tasks", even for 1.
items.instead: Use a fixed subject, pluralize correctly, or leave out the counts.

items.question: Which time zone, and which day, decides that it is Monday?
items.chose: Formats the instant as an English weekday name in the given time zone and checks it equals "Monday".
items.instead: Use the UTC weekday. Or let the caller decide and add no due check.

items.question: What happens with an unknown time zone, or when the time zone is irrelevant (no open tasks)?
items.chose: Throws an Error naming the zone, and buildDigest validates the zone before the empty check, so it throws even when there are no tasks.
items.instead: Skip time zone validation in buildDigest, since it does not use the zone, and return null for an empty list. Or fall back to UTC.

items.question: Does buildDigest check that it is Monday before building?
items.chose: Builds the digest on any day, without calling isDigestDue.
items.instead: Return null when it is not Monday.
